arxiv-2110-09859.title: TG-hyperbolicity of Composition of Virtual Knots
arxiv-2110-09859.creator: Colin Adams, Alexander Simons
arxiv-2110-09859.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Colin Adams, Alexander Simons. The composition of any two nontrivial classical knots is a satellite knot, and thus, by work of Thurston, is not hyperbolic. In this paper, we explore the composition of virtual knots, which are an extension of classical knots that generalize the idea of knots in S 3 S^{3} to knots in S × I S\times I where S S is a closed orientable surface. We prove that for any two hyperbolic virtual knots, there is a composition that is hyperbolic.

arxiv-2111-05713.title: Towards More Reliable Automated Program Repair by Integrating Static Analysis Techniques Thanks: This work has been financially supported by the Research Council of Norway through the secureIT project (RCN contract #288787).
arxiv-2111-05713.creator: Omar I. Al-Bataineh, Anastasiia Grishina, Leon Moonen
arxiv-2111-05713.description: Abstract A long-standing open challenge for automated program repair is the overfitting problem, which is caused by having insufficient or incomplete specifications to validate whether a generated patch is correct or not. Most available repair systems rely on weak specifications (i.e., specifications that are synthesized from test cases) which limits the quality of generated repairs.

arxiv-2112-07257.title: Data-driven chimney fire risk prediction using machine learning and point process tools.
arxiv-2112-07257.creator: C. Lu
arxiv-2112-07257.description: Abstract Abstract Chimney fires constitute one of the most commonly occurring fire types. Precise prediction and prompt prevention are crucial in reducing the harm they cause. In this paper, we develop a combined machine learning and statistical modeling process to predict chimney fires. Firstly, we use random forests and permutation importance techniques to identify the most informative explanatory variables.

arxiv-2305-05806.title: Calculation of hyperfine structure of erbium and fermium.
arxiv-2305-05806.creator: V. A. Dzuba, V. V. Flambaum
arxiv-2305-05806.description: Abstract A version of the configuration interaction method, which has been recently developed to deal with large number of valence electrons, has been used to calculate magnetic dipole and electric quadrupole hyperfine structure constants for a number of states of erbium and fermium. Calculations for fermium are done for extracting nuclear moments of Fm isotopes from recent and future measurements.

arxiv-2308-01476.title: Physically motivated modeling of LyC escape fraction during reionization
arxiv-2308-01476.creator: Ivan Kostyuk, Benedetta Ciardi, Andrea Ferrara
arxiv-2308-01476.description: Abstract Aims. We present an analysis of the Lyman continuum (LyC) escape fraction of high redshift galaxies using an analytic post-processing approach. Methods. We apply the model to ∼ 6 × 10 5 \sim 6\times 10^{5} galaxies of the Illustris TNG50 simulation in the redshift range z = 5.2 − 20 z=5.2-20 . Results.

arxiv-2311-09715.title: Measurement of Z ​ Z ZZ production cross-sections in the four-lepton final state in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13.6 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13.6\penalty\ \text{TeV} with the ATLAS experiment
arxiv-2311-09715.description: Abstract This paper reports cross-section measurements of Z ​ Z ZZ production in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13.6 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13.6\penalty\ \text{TeV} at the Large Hadron Collider. The data were collected by the ATLAS detector in 2022, and correspond to an integrated luminosity of 29 fb -1 .

arxiv-2402-01297.title: Characterizing Overfitting in Kernel Ridgeless Regression Through the Eigenspectrum
arxiv-2402-01297.creator: Tin Sum Cheng, Aurelien Lucchi, Anastasis Kratsios, David Belius
arxiv-2402-01297.description: Abstract We derive new bounds for the condition number of kernel matrices, which we then use to enhance existing non-asymptotic test error bounds for kernel ridgeless regression (KRR) in the over-parameterized regime for a fixed input dimension. For kernels with polynomial spectral decay, we recover the bound from previous work; for exponential decay, our bound is non-trivial and novel.

arxiv-2503-19920.title: Most stringent bound on electron neutrino mass obtained with a scalable low temperature microcalorimeter array
arxiv-2503-19920.creator: B.K. Alpert, M. Balata, D.T. Becker, D.A. Bennett, M. Borghesi, P. Campana, R. Carobene, M. De Gerone, W.B. Doriese, M. Faverzani, L. Ferrari Barusso, E. Ferri, J.W. arxiv-2503-19920.description: Abstract The determination of the absolute neutrino mass scale remains a fundamental open question in particle physics, with profound implications for both the Standard Model and cosmology. Direct kinematic measurements, independent of model-dependent assumptions, provide the most robust approach to address this challenge.

pmc-11307114.title: Holistic and Personalized Strategies for Managing in Elderly Type 2 Diabetes Patients
pmc-11307114.creator: Jae-Seung Yun, Kyuho Kim, Yu-Bae Ahn, Kyungdo Han, Seung-Hyun Ko
pmc-11307114.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Due to increased life expectancy and lifestyle changes, the prevalence of diabetes among the elderly in Korea is continuously rising, as is the associated public health burden. Diabetes management in elderly patients is complicated by age-related physiological changes, sarcopenia characterized by loss of muscle mass and function, comorbidities, and varying levels of functional, cognitive, and mobility abilities that lead to frailty.

pmc-11673495.title: Green Tea Catechins and Skin Health
pmc-11673495.creator: Xin-Qiang Zheng, Xue-Han Zhang, Han-Qing Gao, Lan-Ying Huang, Jing-Jing Ye, Jian-Hui Ye, Jian-Liang Lu, Shi-Cheng Ma, Yue-Rong Liang, Rubia Casagrande
pmc-11673495.description: Green tea catechins (GTCs) are a group of bioactive polyphenolic compounds found in fresh tea leaves (Camellia sinensis (L.) O. Kuntze). They have garnered significant attention due to their diverse health benefits and potential therapeutic applications, including as antioxidant and sunscreen agents.

pmc-11691064.title: METABOLOME-WIDE STUDY OF CVD IN SWEDISH TWINS
pmc-11691064.creator: Asmus Cosmos Skovgaard, Jonathan K L Mak, Sara Hägg, Juulia Jylhävä, Mette Soerensen
pmc-11691064.description: Globally, cardiovascular diseases (CVD) are the leading cause of death, with coronary artery disease (CAD) and stroke as the most frequent diseases. The molecular basis of CVD is potentially confounded by genetic and environmental factors, an issue which is reduced by investigating intra-pair differences in twins.

pmc-11862521.title: Vitamin D, vitamin B12, folate, homocysteine, and major haemato-chemical parameters in patients with mood disorders
pmc-11862521.creator: D. Marazziti, R. Gurrieri, F. Mucci
pmc-11862521.description: IntroductionThe potential involvement of the immune and inflammatory systems has been extensively studied in mood disorders (MDs). Despite these findings and despite the fact that the pathogenetic role of altered immunologic and metabolic profiles in MDs is being confirmed in many current studies, there is still a lack of consensus about it, due to controversial results.

pmc-12361409.title: The nature of phantom dark energy and its relation to time crystals
pmc-12361409.creator: Laura Mersini-Houghton
pmc-12361409.description: In this letter we show that, at its fundamental level, phantom dark energy is a fluid made up of time crystals that permeate the fabric of space-time. In turn, any well-behaved stable theory of a non-canonical scalar field that acts as phantom dark energy also leads to the production of time crystals.

pmc-12375048.title: ANN assisted design of broadband near perfect metasurface absorbers exploiting InAs nanorods for visible light harvesting
pmc-12375048.creator: Ershad Sharifi, Mohammad Razaghi, Keyhan Hosseini
pmc-12375048.description: This research focuses on the design of broadband, polarization-insensitive absorber layers based on all-dielectric metasurfaces for use across the entire visible light spectrum, i.e., 400–800 nm, for applications in solar cells and photovoltaic devices. The patterned metasurfaces utilize InAs nanorods with two different radii and heights, whose size diversity generates optical resonances at diverse wavelengths and increases the absorption bandwidth.

pmc-12529186.title: Ni-Doped MoS2/N-Doped Carbon Hollow Nanostructures for Sodium-Ion Half and Full Batteries
pmc-12529186.creator: Songya Cui, Jiashuo Wang, Chengxiang Tian, Xiaoyu Xu, Dongxue Han, Guang Chen, Yufeng Yu, Liang Peng
pmc-12529186.description: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) are restricted in their energy storage capacity primarily because the considerable size of Na+ and inherently slow redox processes limit efficient charge transfer. Transition metal chalcogenides with layered structures have considerable promise as advanced materials of SIBs. Herein, the Ni-doped hollow MoS2/NC spheres with nitrogen-doped carbon are fabricated by a simple water/ethanol system combined with thermal annealing.

pmc-12532919.title: Physicians’ opinions on and practical experiences with palliative sedation therapy in children: an international survey in five European countries
pmc-12532919.creator: Hanna Fischer, Deborah Gubler, Arjanne M van Norel, Eva Bergsträsser, Joana Mendes, Ana Lacerda, Erna Michiels, Jitka Kosikova, Kristýna Poláková, Sara Depulpaep, Yoni Aelvoet, Laure Dombrecht, Kim Beernaert
pmc-12532919.description: BackgroundPalliative sedation therapy (PST) is used in the end of life (EOL) phase for terminally ill patients to alleviate refractory symptoms by lowering consciousness. This applies to both adults and children. No international comparative studies on the practice of paediatric PST exist, although such knowledge is needed for the development of guidelines and a broader discussion, including ethical aspects.

pmc-13157353.title: Research Trends in HIV-Associated Nephropathy (HIVAN) from 2015 to 2025: A Bibliometric Analysis Using CiteSpace
pmc-13157353.creator: Shaowei Huang, Xiaofeng Wei
pmc-13157353.description: BackgroundIn recent years, HIV-associated nephropathy (HIVAN) has significantly impacted the compliance, quality of life, and treatment outcomes for patients with AIDS. This study employs CiteSpace bibliometric analysis to predict emerging topics and research trends, thereby offering clear scientific navigation and strategic recommendations for HIVAN research.

pmc-13201715.title: The aMAP score combined with plasma cfDNA methylation testing for risk stratification in hepatitis population: a case-control study

pmc-13201715.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Effective surveillance of the hepatitis populations reduces liver cancer incidence and improves prognosis. This study aimed to develop an easy and non-invasive risk assessment model for this population. A total of 392 subjects were included in the present study, comprising 72 cases of chronic hepatitis, 31 cases of liver fibrosis, 152 cases of cirrhosis and 137 cases of liver cancer from diverse ethnic groups in China.

pmc-13670045.title: Single-operator cholangioscopy in the diagnosis and treatment planning of hilar intraductal papillary neoplasia of the bile duct: a case report

pmc-13670045.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A 53-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and cholestasis with normal bilirubin. Computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging/magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography suggested a perihilar stricture but could not exclude left-duct extension, and initial multidisciplinary review deemed the case unresectable. Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography with peroral single-operator cholangioscopy (SOC) obtained biopsy specimens, but the stricture was not traversable; repeat multidisciplinary review pursued antegrade mapping.
